_comment: Olesm's INN register. Attached ONLY to olesm_inn_guest; his desk hub (olesm_intro) never rides along, so the chess WAGER, the puzzle, the rematch residue and every council briefing stay home-only (REGISTER-PURE). What survives is chess-ADJACENT: he reads the ROOM like a position. Serve mirrors selys_inn/patron_serving: {once_per_waking, item} sanctioned compound, banks the shared served_customer counter. Voice per docs/design/character-profiles.md: earnest, self-deprecating about the night off, quietly proud.

greet.speaker: Olesm
greet.text: Oh, good, a friendly face. I promised myself one night off and I have spent it counting how many people can reach that door before I can.

offduty.speaker: Olesm
offduty.text: Every room is a position, and I never asked to see them that way. Your hearth is the strong square. The stairs I haven't worked out yet — an open file, possibly, but I keep revising it. Whoever sits with their back to the door is brave or new. It happens on its own, and my stew goes cold in the meantime.

options.text: "Eat something before it goes cold, then."

served.speaker: Olesm
served.text: Oh. That is properly hot. I had it in my head I would eat later. I've been saying later for three hours. Thank you. Really — thank you.
